example.translation: The book is on the table.

example.text: Nasa tabi ng mesa ang upuan.
example.translation: The chair is next to the table.
The bed is in my room.
The cat is on the sofa.

usage_notes: Refers to rice that has been cooked.
In this entry, araw means sun; it can also mean day in other contexts.
In this entry, buwan means moon; it can also mean month in other contexts.

example.text: Nakikita ko ang kapatid na babae.
Nakikita ko ang kapatid na lalaki.
Gusto kong maghugas ng mga plato.
example.translation: I want to wash the dishes.
I want to open the door.
I want to close the door.
I want to push the cart.
I want to pull the rope.

usage_notes: Siling kampana means bell pepper, rather than black pepper.
